name: Clockwise
tagline: Clockwise is an AI calendar assistant that automatically optimises meeting schedules to create blocks of uninterrupted Focus Time. It reschedules flexible meetings across teams to minimise context-switching, balances workloads, and can schedule meetings via natural language with its Prism AI assistant.
